categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: agricultural machinery chain sales and services, and high-end specialized agricultural machinery R&D and manufacturing. The sales segment includes direct chain stores and agency sales across multiple provinces, offering a wide range of agricultural machinery and comprehensive services. The manufacturing segment, led by the subsidiary Jilin Kangda, focuses on developing and producing no-till precision fertilizer seeders, deep loosening tillage machines, and disc harrows, targeting protective tillage markets in northern China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced agricultural machinery technologies such as intelligent no-till seeding machines equipped with monitoring systems for precise operation control. It develops integrated machines capable of performing multiple operations in one pass, such as side deep fertilization, residue clearing, seedbed preparation, and soil compaction. The R&D also focuses on key metal components, proprietary materials, and electric-driven precision seeding technologies, maintaining a leading position with over 20 patents and multiple awards in no-till machinery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include end-users in agriculture, particularly farmers and agricultural service providers engaged in mechanized planting, fertilizing, and tillage. The company serves regions with protective tillage practices, including Northeast, Northwest, and North China. It also targets emerging markets in hilly and mountainous areas and extends services to economic crops, livestock, and aquaculture sectors. The sales network covers both direct retail customers and dealers who serve county and township markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with direct chain stores in 20 provinces and a dense dealer network covering over 1,700 outlets nationwide. Major regional markets include Southwest, Northeast, Northwest, East China, and South China. The manufacturing subsidiary focuses on northern regions such as Northeast and Northwest China. The company is also exploring overseas markets including Russia and Central Asia through its manufacturing arm.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the agricultural machinery supply chain. It acts as a major distributor and retailer of agricultural machinery products, linking upstream manufacturers with end-users. Additionally, through its manufacturing subsidiaries, it participates in upstream production of specialized agricultural machinery and components, integrating R&D, production, and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on integrating high-end, intelligent, and green agricultural machinery technologies to align with industry trends toward full mechanization and digitalization. R&D priorities include developing intelligent no-till seeding machines, precision fertilization equipment, and machinery adapted for hilly terrain. The company pursues upstream integration via acquisitions and joint ventures in smart agricultural equipment and core components, while expanding its service ecosystem and deepening market penetration through network densification and channel consolidation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of agricultural machinery products via direct retail and agency channels. The company also earns income from after-sales services including maintenance, installation, technical training, and comprehensive mechanization solutions. Manufacturing sales contribute a smaller portion of revenue, focusing on specialized machinery. Other minor revenue streams include leasing, consulting, and repair services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's agricultural machinery distribution sector, distinguished as the only listed company with a nationwide chain network. It holds stable regional agency rights for multiple major domestic and international brands, including John Deere, Kubota, and DJI. In manufacturing, its subsidiary Kangda is a recognized leader in no-till seeding machinery but faces intensified competition in the corn seeder segment due to new entrants and market saturation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.71 billion, a 2.24% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders declining to a loss of RMB 30.8 million. The company maintains total assets around RMB 1.87 billion and equity of RMB 536 million. Despite revenue growth, profitability was impacted by intensified competition and increased share-based payment expenses. The company continues to expand its retail network, adding 18 new direct stores in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a multi-category, premium brand, and professional chain operation model, offering tailored mechanization solutions and superior service capabilities. Its extensive sales network and strong brand recognition provide customers with reliable access to diverse agricultural machinery products. The manufacturing segment differentiates through advanced no-till technology, environmental benefits, and integration of intelligent monitoring systems, supporting sustainable agriculture and operational efficiency.
